title: Earn $20 Daily Trading the World Cup Through the Finals
summary: Gemini Predictions traders can earn up to $20 every day trading the World Cup.
body_markdown:
The World Cup group stage drama is behind us. The Round of 32 and Round of 16 are done. Most teams remaining are one win away from a semifinals, with France securing the first spot with a win over Morocco on Thursday.


Gemini has been running a knockout stage promo since June 29, but there’s still 10 days left to trade and earn rewards.


### Trade & Earn Daily Rewards


The knockout stage has already delivered penalty shootouts, last-minute winners, and a few genuine upsets. From here on, every match is win-or-go-home, and every market gives you a new chance to earn rewards while it plays out.


**Earn $5 for every $25+ trade on World Cup contracts, up to $20 daily, through the final.**


Here's where things stand:


- Quarterfinals: July 9–11


- Semifinals: July 14–15


- Final: July 19


Don't just watch history. Get rewarded for trading it. Rewards capped at $20 daily through the final. See terms for full details.
